rows.text: measures the zero-terminated string at `rcx`; returns 0 when its first byte is `_` (`0x5F`), otherwise walks the bytes up to the next `_` or the string end, folding each byte from `0` to `9` into `value * 10 + digit` and skipping every other byte, and returns the value

masks `edx` to its low 24 bits; when qword `[rcx + 0x100]` is null it returns the masked value, when the value is below (signed) that table's first dword it returns dword `[table + 4 + value * 4]`, and otherwise it returns 0

returns 0 for a null `rcx`; otherwise, when dword `[rcx]` is not -1, it first (only if `edx` is nonzero) calls `0042F250(word [rcx])`, ORs `0xB` into byte `+0x10` and sets byte `+0x11` to `(byte AND 0x9F) OR 6`, then passes dword `[rcx]` to a 103-byte release and dword `+4` to a 92-byte list lookup and stores -1 to qword `[rcx]`; in both cases it then masks byte `+0x10` to its low nibble, stores -1 to dword `[rcx]` and 0 to qword `+8`, calls a 29-byte flag setter with both flags zero and stores 0 to dword `+0x20`, returning 1 when the release ran and 0 when `[rcx]` was -1

pops a value through `VMValueStack_PopInt32CoerceFloat32(r9)`; when byte `[rdx + 0x20]` is non-negative it passes it sign-extended to a 63-byte slot release; it then stores to byte `[rdx + 0x20]` the result of the 318-byte four-slot allocator called with `(0, value)`, and tail-jumps a 7-byte byte-global setter with `ecx = 1`

picks the 24-byte record `(ecx AND 0xF) * 0x18` into `022D9AE0` when any of bits 4 to 7 of `ecx` is set, else into `022D9AB0` (a null record when `ecx` is -1); it resolves dword `[rec + 0xC]` through a 79-byte resolver, reads dword `[resolved - 0x28]` (0 for null) through a 12-byte getter, and stores to dword `[rec + 4]` the result of a 5-byte thunk called with `ecx` = signed byte `+1` (plus 2 when byte `+2` is nonzero), `edx` = signed word `+0x14`, the resolved pointer, that dword and 1; a zero result passes `+0xC` to an 85-byte release, zeroes `+0xC` and stores 3 to byte `[rec]`, a nonzero result stores 3 there only when dword `+8` is nonzero

when byte `022D9B40` is 2 it stores 1 there, calls a 5-byte thunk with `ecx = 0` and passes each 24-byte record from `022D9AB0` below `022D9AE0` whose first byte is 3 to a 342-byte routine; then, when byte `022D9B41` is 2, it stores 1 there, calls the same thunk with `ecx = 1` and does the same for the records from `022D9AE0` below `022D9B40`

when `ecx` is nonzero it scans the four 24-byte records at `022D9AE0`, else the two at `022D9AB0`, and returns the first record whose first byte is nonzero and whose sign-extended word `+0x14` equals `edx`; returns null when none matches

resolves dword `[rdx]` through `ImageAddress_ResolveRuntimePointer`, stores `RuntimePointer_EncodeImageAddress` of the low 32 bits of `rdx` plus that result back to dword `[rdx]`, then stores `RuntimePointer_EncodeImageAddress(rdx)` to dword `[rcx]`

resolves dword `[rdx + 0x30]` through `ImageAddress_ResolveRuntimePointer`, stores `RuntimePointer_EncodeImageAddress` of the low 32 bits of `rdx` plus that result back to dword `[rdx + 0x30]`, then stores `RuntimePointer_EncodeImageAddress(rdx)` to dword `[rcx]`
resolves dword `[rcx]` through `ImageAddress_ResolveRuntimePointer` and stores `RuntimePointer_EncodeImageAddress` of the low 32 bits of `edx` plus that result back to dword `[rcx]`

resolves dword `[rdx + 0x10]` through `ImageAddress_ResolveRuntimePointer`, stores `RuntimePointer_EncodeImageAddress` of the low 32 bits of `rdx` plus that result back to dword `[rdx + 0x10]`, then stores `RuntimePointer_EncodeImageAddress(rdx)` to dword `[rcx]`
loads dword `[rcx + 0x20]` into `r8d` and tail-jumps to a 138-byte routine with `rcx` and `rdx` unchanged
